mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 73-degree temperatures and clear skies at the Verona Area High School. We are currently seeing a Waxing Gibbous moon.

The City of Verona is currently recruiting for an Engineering Technician. This role involves managing municipal construction projects from design through inspection, including utilities and transportation infrastructure. Interested residents should apply by September 20, 2026.

We have a busy day in Verona with live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus a girls try hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, yoga is scheduled for tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident from Friday, August 15, where a 44-year-old woman was arrested for her first offence O W I after officers found her unresponsive in her vehicle.
Today's delicious Flavor of the Day is Caramel Cashew. You can also visit the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park until 5 PM or the VAHS stadium until 7:30 PM today.
